faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about POS Mining
faq.a1: No KYC, registration or deposit required. Just hold USDC in your wallet.
faq.q2: Are funds safe on this platform?
faq.a2: Yes. Your assets never leave your wallet. All earnings are distributed automatically and transparently, while you keep full control of your funds at all times.
faq.a3: The system provides liquidity across DeFi markets and Proof-of-Stake pools, and rewards users with trading and network profits auto-converted to USDC daily.
faq.q4: Can I withdraw at any time?
faq.a4: Yes, you are free to withdraw and use your funds at any time. There is no lock-in period; your USDC is always available in your own wallet.
faq.a5: Compounding means returns are periodically added to the base amount, so the next period is calculated on a larger total.
faq.a6: POS Mining operates through smart contracts on the Polygon blockchain. Simply deposit USDC on the Polygon network, and all withdrawals are settled in USDC.
faq.a7: First, create a Polygon network wallet, then transfer USDC to your wallet, choose a suitable plan, and you can start earning returns.
